classes.3: intentional special mechanic, needs Tyler's explicit approval

status.C: confirmed: the code path was read, measured where the row says so
status.H: hypothesis: the row says what would confirm it

formulas.computes: A hero's largest blow (maxHit): floor(0.35 x (weapon skill + worn +skill) + 0.6 x summed damage bonus + 2), then x the weakness factor, then x (1 + damage buff). Never under 1
formulas.params: literals 0.35 / 0.6 / 2 at combat.js:391. COMBAT_BALANCE.strengthLevelScale / strengthBonusScale / playerBaseMaxHit (combat.js:38-40) hold the same numbers but the engine never reads them

formulas.computes: A hero's chance to land a basic blow: ratio(20 + skill + worn accuracy, the monster's evasion) x 1.15 on a weak-weapon match, held to 5%..97%. Steady then turns a share of the misses into hits
formulas.params: TO_HIT { base 20, min 0.05, max 0.97 } (to-hit.js:117). WEAKNESS_BONUS.accuracy 1.15 (combat.js:31)

formulas.computes: One basic blow: miss is 0, a hit is a whole number 1..maxHit with equal odds (mean (maxHit + 1) / 2)
formulas.params: none of its own
formulas.random: the hunt seed stream: chance, then int

formulas.computes: Critical basic blows: chance = clamp(gear critB + crit buff + set bonus + Keen, 0, 0.60). A crit is max(damage + 1, floor(damage x 1.5)). The set bonus is 1% a tier for 5+ armor pieces of one tier and line
formulas.params: COMBAT_BALANCE.critMult 1.5, critCap 0.60 (combat.js:64-65). Leather critB the same on every piece, the leather profile even critB over the defense budget (gear-profiles.js; 0.028 at Dawnsteel)
formulas.random: one chance draw on a landed hero blow with a chance above 0

formulas.computes: The damage factor against one monster: weapon weakness 1.20 x bane (at most 1.40) x weapon element (at most 1.15), the product held to 1.90. A weapon match also gives x1.15 accuracy
formulas.params: WEAKNESS_BONUS (combat.js:31), MAX_BANE_MULT 1.40 (core-model.js:256), MAX_ELEMENT_MULT 1.15 and MAX_TOTAL_DAMAGE_MULT 1.90 (elements.js:56-60), MAX_COMBINED_DAMAGE_MULT 1.68 (bane.js:62, unused)

formulas.computes: Every amount that lands on a unit, in this order. On a monster: x element (a weakness at the tag's weakPm share) then minus the defence cut, x the cast's power (version, store, surge, mark), x the boss guard, x the dealer's stance, x the target's stance, at least 1, x Tempering. On a hero: x power, x stances, then the armor chain. Then the spell shell, then HP
formulas.params: no numbers of its own. Nine floors in a row
formulas.random: none itself (Tempering's part of a point: one draw)

formulas.computes: A monster's defence: floor(def x 0.03) whole points off every blow and every tick it takes
formulas.params: COMBAT_BALANCE.monsterDefenseDamageReduction 0.03. def = 0.08 x Level x role (balance-sheet.js STAT_FORMULA.def, MONSTER_ROLES)

formulas.computes: What an element is worth on a monster: 1000 - 10 x its profile's percent, the percent held to ELEMENT_PCT. A row with weakPm lands only that share of a weakness
formulas.params: ELEMENT_PCT bounds (src/data/elements.js). weak +15, resist 25, former immunity 50 (ruling 2026-11-06)

formulas.computes: A target that takes more: Hunter's Mark (unit fields markPm until markUntil) plus the strongest marking status (takenPm), added and folded into the cast's power
formulas.params: the mark row's bonusPct and durMs (abilities.js). Sickness takenPm 100 for 6 s (statuses.js)

formulas.computes: Stance: Offensive deals and takes x1.10, Defensive deals x0.90 and takes x0.85
formulas.params: HUNT_STANCES

formulas.computes: The steady cut: worn steadyPm (a cape) and a food's steady lower what reaches the hero, last, never past the cap. The part of a point is a chance (the old Tempering rungs that shared it retired with lane/tp-im-steps)
formulas.params: src/data/items.js capes steadyPm; a food's steady buff
formulas.random: one draw a blow, only for a hero carrying a cut

formulas.computes: A damaging cast: each hit rolls a whole number from max(ceil(top / 2), base lo) to max(top, base hi), top = floor(maxHit x hitPm / 1000). Then C-HURT. It never misses and never crits
formulas.params: each row's hitPm and base (abilities.js:159-336). ABILITY_RULES.hitLowPm 500

formulas.computes: A heal: floor(max(floor(maxHit x healPm / 1000), base) x power / 1000), whole (no roll), x Tempering, less the heal cut, capped at missing HP. Mend alone: floor(maxHp x 110 / 1000) x power
formulas.params: each row's healPm and base. Mend healHpPm 110 (abilities.js:335)
consumers: survival, E-SUPPLY-USE (economy: a heal replaces food)

formulas.computes: A shell: floor(max(floor(maxHit x shieldPm / 1000), base) x power / 1000), a pool that a blow spends before HP. A recast of a self shell refunds the unused part as mana. A party shell never lowers a bigger one
formulas.params: each row's shieldPm and base

formulas.computes: A cast's power in permille: the rune tier's step (1000 / 1100 / 1200 / 1300 / 1400 at each tier's skill gate, runes.js versionLevel) x the store's share for a store rune x Surge when it surges
formulas.params: RUNE_TIERS stepPm and level. BASIC_EFFECT_SHARE (supply-basics.js). SURGE_MULT_PM (jewelry.js)
formulas.random: Surge: one draw a cast for a wearer

formulas.computes: Statuses, one generic engine: a ticking one (Bleed: scale = max(tier share, floor(maxHit x 33 x tier share / 1000)), tick = round(roll 1..3 x scale / 1000) a stack a second, 5 stacks, 6 s), a marking one (takenPm), a slowing one (Chill: clock x (1000 + slowPm) / 1000, 30% to 50% by rune tier), a heal-cutting one (Withered)
formulas.params: STATUSES rows. Bleed tierPermille [1000..1400], Chill tierPermille [1000..1667]
formulas.random: one int a tick for a ranged tick

formulas.computes: Every heal a Withered unit takes: n - floor(n x cut / 1000). A hero 30% (less by its necrotic resistance), a monster 50%
formulas.params: STATUSES.withered healCutPm (dark behind NECROTIC_STORM.live)

formulas.computes: Life leech: floor(HP a hit took x leechPm / 1000) back to the caster (Reave 300). Mana back: min(mana spent, hits x manaPerHit + kills x manaPerKill). Focus: a kill returns focusPm of max mana
formulas.params: row fields leechPm, manaPerHit, manaPerKill (abilities.js:321-327). jewel focus

formulas.computes: Attack speed: every basic attack is 2,000 ms for heroes and monsters with no speed modifier. A cast locks its lane (offense 2 s, support 2 s, heal 1 s) and its own cooldown. Chill stretches a swing and a windup
formulas.params: tickMs 2000 (ruled 2026-10-15). Lanes. Each row's cdMs

formulas.computes: Mana: regenerates 25% of max a minute x the Inner Flame rate. A caster's basic costs 1 mana. A cast costs its version's mana, never more with level
formulas.params: ABILITY_RULES.manaRegenPctPerMin 25

formulas.computes: HP regeneration: 0.3% of max a second in a fight and 6% out of one, x the Inner Flame rate 1 + P / (P + 50). The fist wraps add selfHealPm a second
formulas.params: VITALS.inFightRegenPermillePerS 3 (core-model.js). HUNT_TUNING.oocRegenPermillePerS 60. FLAME_REGEN { maxPermille 1000, k 50 }

formulas.computes: A monster's largest blow: floor(atk x the art tier's scale), scale 5.4 for tiers 1-2, 4.0 for 3-4, 3.0 for 5, 2.2 for 6. It rolls 1..that like a hero's
formulas.params: COMBAT_BALANCE.monsterAttackDamageScale 5.4 and monsterDamageScaleByTier (combat.js:45-56), restated as balance-sheet.js:340 DAMAGE_SCALE_BY_TIER

formulas.computes: A monster's chance to land: ratio(aim, 20 + Defense + worn +Defense + guard), held to 5%..97%. Guard is the defB of gear outside the armor weights (a shield, a cape)
formulas.params: TO_HIT

formulas.computes: What armor does to a landed blow, in fixed order: dodge (medium) = floor(650 x P / (P + 0.4 x L)), absorb (heavy) = floor(750 x P / (P + 0.62 x L)), the resistance, ward (light) = floor(P x 1.5) flat, Tempering, and never more than 60% in all. L is the ATTACKER's Level, with the tier's dial on it
formulas.params: ARMOUR_MITIGATION (core-model.js:168-173). ARMOUR_WEIGHT
formulas.random: dodge: one chance draw for a medium wearer

formulas.computes: A hero's resistance: taken = 1000 - min(cap, summed worn resistPm), cap 40% an element and 10% physical. Storm also burns mana for half the HP it took. Necrotic lands Withered
formulas.params: HERO_RESIST_PM and ELEMENT_ON_HERO (src/data/elements.js)

formulas.computes: A monster row from its Level, role, ground floor and fit: HP = (4.95 + 1.76 x L) x role x fit, blow = a share (13.2% to 22%) of a same-Level hero's base HP, aim and evasion from the reference hero (lands 70%, is landed on 85%), def = 0.08 x L x role
formulas.params: STAT_FORMULA { ramp 8..16, hit 0.40..0.70, heroHit 0.85, blow 0.132..0.22, gentleCap 0.11, hp, def, fit.party }. MONSTER_ROLES
consumers: P-KILL-XP (progression: xp is on the same row)
E-KILL-COIN (economy: gp is on the same row)

formulas.computes: The reference hero a monster is written against: a measured career (the lone hammer) [Level, skill, Defense, worn accuracy] every 5 Levels to 100, sparser to 1,000, straight past it. aimFor and evasionFor invert the ratio
formulas.params: REF_HERO (generated). Worn accuracy stops at 32 from Level 90

formulas.computes: Normal, Dangerous, Deadly: a pull size and three dials. dmgPm multiplies atk, aim AND the monster's Level as armor reads it. hpPm its HP. xpPm its kill XP. On a gentle ground the tier first takes back the ground's kindness, so its dmgPm is solved per floor
formulas.params: TIER_DIALS { dangerous: pull 8, lift 0.8, 1170 / 1100 / 1100. deadly: pull 8, lift 1, 1330 / 1150 / 1250 }. TIER_PULL_FROM_FLOOR 16. Four grounds carry their own dials

formulas.computes: A monster's spell: it rolls from half to all of floor(its largest blow x hitPm / 1000), then the hero's armor as any blow. A worn shield takes 30% off a marked spell. A mend puts the same roll back on a packmate. The first cast waits a random share of the cooldown
formulas.params: each spell row. SPELL_ROLL.lowPm 500. SHIELD_BRACE.markedPm 300. FAIR_WARNING. SPELL_STAGGER.spanPm 1000
formulas.random: int a hit. The stagger draw

formulas.computes: A boss's two lines on his HP: adds arrive at addsPm and he takes only guardPm of every blow while one stands. Under enragePm his atk and aim are x enrageAtkPm, and one named spell's cooldown is x cdPm
formulas.params: each boss row's phases (monsters.js:830,845. grounds/krells_hold/pack.js:350,360. grounds/muster_barrows/pack.js:178)

formulas.computes: A boss room: one fight, a time limit, his kill ends it, nothing resets. A called room pays nothing. A keyed hall pays as a ground. A boss is the formula's boss role: HP x5, blow x1.1 held to 33% of the FLOOR hero's HP
formulas.params: BOSS_CALL_RULES.limitMs 10 min. BOSS_HALL_RULES. MONSTER_ROLES.boss.floorCap 0.33

formulas.computes: A Burning Tower floor or a Catacomb room F: 5 monsters, each the stat formula at Level F on a floor-F ground, a Keeper (boss role) every 10th. Past floor 100 every blow is x1.012 a floor, compounding. Floor 300 is the last row
formulas.params: TOWER_RULES / CATACOMB_RULES { roomSize 5, landingEvery 10, floorTop 300, heat { from 100, perFloorPm 12 }, limits 3 and 10 min }
formulas.random: deterministic (rooms are picked by number, no dice)

formulas.computes: A scaled hunt: the same formula with the ground's floor moved to the leader's Level and every monster up by the same gap. Normal and Dangerous only
formulas.params: SCALED_HUNTS { xpPm 730, partyPm 700, coinPm, tiers }. SCALE_EXCEPTIONS (the Thicket at half danger)

formulas.computes: Aggro is rules, not threat numbers: a pack turns on the pull's leader. Challenge takes every monster within 6 tiles that is not on a tank and holds it 8 s. A Healer's basic draws a free monster 18% of the time. A shooter aims at the hero farthest back. A tank under 90% of the strongest tank's HP never takes a turn
formulas.params: CHALLENGE { radius 6, holdMs 8000, holderMinHpPm 900 }. Healer peel 180
consumers: P-DEFENSE-XP (progression: only blows taken train it)

formulas.computes: Area and extra targets: a shape (the 3x3, a line of len, a ring of r) hits every engaged monster it covers for the FULL roll each, up to maxHits. Follow-through repeats a basic blow on one neighbour. An area arrow hits its footprint
formulas.params: ABILITY_RULES.areaSide 3. Row fields len, r, maxHits (Turning Cut 8)
deps: C-TIER (the pull is how many stand there)

formulas.computes: A pack lives in its room plus a margin (1 tile unless the ground says more). If the aggro holder leaves, the pack resets and heals. A called or keyed boss never resets
formulas.params: HUNT_TUNING.leashMarginDefault 1. A ground's leashMargin

formulas.computes: How many stand in a fight: the ground's packs on Normal, the tier's pull on a harder tier (8, the Glade's Dangerous 6, none under floor 16). A monster's HP is its row's x hpPm for every party size
formulas.params: TIER_DIALS pulls. Ground pockets

formulas.computes: Armor points: the one gear formula (src/core/gear-stats.js gearStats): the weight's profile (plate 1000, leather 550, cloth 300 permille) x the slot's share (GEAR_SLOT_PM) x the defense budget at the piece's item Level, each line's trades a share of the same budget, a named piece its statPlus; on a Danger-scale ground read at the ground's base item Level (scaleItems). Past tier 7 the staged line is Dawnsteel x max(1, Level / 110), and each unique is hand-sized under it
formulas.params: the defense curve, the slot split, the weights' profiles. LINE_ANCHOR_LEVEL 110, LINE_TRADE 0.05

formulas.computes: Weapon accuracy and damage: the one gear formula, the family's profile x the slot's share (a two-handed weapon the shield's too) x the offense budget at the piece's item Level; on a Danger-scale ground read at the ground's base item Level. Past tier 7 the staged line is Dawnsteel x max(1, Level / 110)
formulas.params: the offense curve and the family profiles. WEAPON_LINE_ANCHOR 110

formulas.computes: Worn modifiers and how each stacks: jewel perks (Keen, Steady, Follow, Surge, Focus) count the largest once. Resistance sums, then caps. +skill sums. The own heal takes the largest. critB sums
formulas.params: each item row

formulas.computes: The injected bonus reader: a food buff or a perk adds to damage, crit and steady (a damage cut). Permanent perks are held to 20%
formulas.params: BUFFS_DEF. PERMANENT_CAP 0.20

formulas.computes: The training yard's dummy: its blow never takes a hero under a floor, and it never falls
formulas.params: the dummy rows

gear is worn by Level. Past tier 7 there is no gear, so combat stops scaling (section 7)
kill XP is priced per monster HP point on the same row. More HP is more XP a kill
Defense trains by the attacker's Level, which a tier multiplies
weapon skills train on HP removed, Magic on mana spent

edgesOut.edge: C-RUN-ROOM -> P-RUN-XP (TOWER_PARTY_XP), party XP tables, the under-floor share

coin a kill is priced per HP point on the same row (GROUND_GP_FIT, gp.line)
kills an hour is hero damage over monster HP plus walking and resting
